title: Angles formed by parallel lines and a transversal
summary: Use corresponding, alternate and co-interior angle relationships.
objectives: Recognise corresponding, alternate and co-interior angle relationships.
Calculate unknown angles formed by parallel lines and a transversal.
Use angle relationships to justify when two lines are parallel.

sections.title: Recognising the F, Z and C relationships

blocks.text: For parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal, alternate interior angles are equal, and co-interior angles on the same side of a transversal total 180°.
